name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz Yilmaz's journey into the world of motorsport was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a fascination for the complex systems that powered Formula 1 cars during his youth. This curiosity led him to pursue a degree in computer engineering. After graduation, Deniz spent several years working for a multinational tech firm, honing his skills in network infrastructure and cybersecurity. However, the allure of motorsport never faded.

He transitioned into the motorsport industry seven years ago, initially joining a smaller racing team before landing his current role at Herberth Motorsport. Deniz views his role as more than just maintaining IT infrastructure; he sees himself as a critical enabler of the team's success, ensuring that data flows seamlessly between departments and that sensitive information remains secure. His calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for quickly troubleshooting complex issues have earned him the respect of his colleagues. He's known for his ability to explain highly technical concepts in a way that everyone can understand, fostering better collaboration between the engineering and IT departments.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Deniz is of average height and build, with a focused gaze and a warm smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn network diagrams.
Has a specific playlist of Turkish rock music he listens to when troubleshooting critical system failures.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, claiming it improves his typing speed and accuracy.
